The best swell direction is from the southwest. Good surf at all stages of the tide. An uncrowded break, even when it is working. Take care of - Rips / undertow. Cox's Bazar

Cox's Bazaar is a sand-bottomed beach break stretched along one of the longest beaches anywhere, some 120 km of Bay of Bengal coastline in Bangladesh. It sits at the very fringe of the novelty destination list, and it's where the country's surfing began: Jafar Alam bought a board from a travelling Australian in 1992 and spent the next decade learning to ride it here. Waves run from ankle-high mush to head-high closeout barrels, and quality is usually poor, so come for the adventure as much as the surf.
